description: Na₅Cr₃F₁₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.54 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.50-2.86 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.42 Å. There are three inequivalent Cr sites. In the first Cr site, Cr is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing CrF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-41°. There are a spread of Cr-F bond distances ranging from 1.92-1.95 Å. In the second Cr site, Cr is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing CrF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 41°. There are a spread of Cr-F bond distances ranging from 1.94-1.98 Å. In the third Cr site, Cr is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing CrF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 36°. There are four shorter (1.94 Å) and two longer (1.96 Å) Cr-F bond lengths. There are seven inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Cr atom. In the second F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Cr atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Cr tetrahedra. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Cr atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two Cr atoms. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Cr atom. In the sixth F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Cr atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Cr tetrahedra. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Na and one Cr atom.
